_about: FL Studio's stock effects, controllers and tools in plain words - our own notes. edition = lowest FL edition that includes it, in line with flh_catalog (plugins it doesn't list: 'Fruity ...' = every edition there; others our best knowledge with verify=true). Settings are starting points, not rules.

cards.title: Fruity Limiter
cards.summary: Limiter, compressor and noise gate in one (LIMIT / COMP / NOISE modes), with a sidechain input. The usual last plugin on the master and the classic FL sidechain tool.
controls: ceiling: the output never goes above it
how fast it grabs and lets go
sidechain input number (signals sent with 'Sidechain to this track')
settings: LIMIT, CEIL about -1 dB, GAIN 0 to +3 dB
COMP, SC = kick, THRES low, RATIO 4-10:1, fast ATT, REL 80-200 ms
NOISE, threshold just above the room noise
tips: Watch the gain-reduction meter: more than 3-4 dB on a master usually sounds squashed.

cards.title: Fruity Compressor
cards.summary: Simple compressor: threshold, ratio, gain, attack, release and curve type. No sidechain input (use Fruity Limiter for that).
settings: 3:1-4:1, attack 5-15 ms, release 60-120 ms, 3-6 dB reduction

cards.title: Fruity Multiband Compressor
cards.summary: Three-band compressor: compress lows, mids and highs separately (control boomy bass or harsh highs without touching the rest).

cards.title: Maximus
cards.summary: Multiband maximizer/compressor/limiter for mastering and heavy dynamics: three bands plus master, each with its own curve. Presets for mastering, de-essing, sidechain.
controls: pick band or master to edit
settings: a mastering preset, then reduce pre gain until reduction is gentle
a de-esser preset on the vocal track

cards.title: Soundgoodizer
cards.summary: One-knob 'make it louder and brighter' effect built on Maximus presets (modes A-D). Quick, but easy to overdo.
tips: Compare at matched loudness - louder often only sounds better.

cards.title: Emphasizer
cards.summary: Simple mastering helper: tone shaping, low-end emphasis and limiting in one small window.

cards.title: Fruity Parametric EQ 2
cards.summary: The main FL EQ: 7 bands with live spectrum. Drag band dots to set frequency and gain; each band can be peak, shelf, pass, notch or band-pass.
controls: right-click a band (or its shape control) for the type
Q / slope of each band (scroll wheel on a band, verify)
settings: high-pass at 80-150 Hz on non-bass parts
+1 to +3 dB high shelf from 10 kHz
tips: Use it before compression for cleanup, after for colour.

cards.title: Fruity Parametric EQ (old)
cards.summary: Older 7-band parametric EQ; Parametric EQ 2 replaces it.

cards.title: Fruity 7 Band EQ
cards.summary: Simple graphic EQ with 7 fixed-frequency sliders.

cards.title: Fruity Reeverb 2
cards.summary: Algorithmic reverb with room size, decay, predelay, damping and low/high cut. A solid default send reverb.
controls: keep the tail out of the lows/highs
gap before the tail (can sync to tempo)
settings: Dry 0, Wet 100%, low cut ~250 Hz, high cut ~8-10 kHz, predelay 20-40 ms

cards.title: Luxeverb
cards.summary: Newer high-quality algorithmic reverb with modulation and a visual tail display; lush halls, plates and shimmer-type sounds.

cards.title: Fruity Convolver
cards.summary: Convolution reverb: loads impulse responses (real rooms, plates, cabinets) and lets you shape their envelope and EQ.

cards.title: Fruity Delay 3
cards.summary: Modern delay: tempo-synced or free time, feedback with filters, modulation, saturation and stereo/ping-pong modes. Covers tape, analog and clean echoes.
settings: 1/4 or dotted 1/8, feedback 25-40%, high cut ~5 kHz, on a send

cards.title: Fruity Delay 2
cards.summary: Simple tempo-based delay: input, feedback level and cutoff, time, stereo mode (normal, inverted, ping-pong).

cards.title: Fruity Delay Bank
cards.summary: Several delay taps, each with its own filter, pan and feedback - complex rhythmic echoes.

cards.title: Fruity Stereo Shaper
cards.summary: Stereo tool: mixes left/right (mono, swap, width), adds small delays or phase offsets for width. Presets for mono-check and widening.
controls: how much of each side goes where (mono, swap)

cards.title: Fruity Stereo Enhancer
cards.summary: Quick stereo widener: stereo separation, phase offset (small delay to one side), pan and volume.

cards.title: Fruity Balance
cards.summary: Volume and pan knobs as a plugin - handy for gain staging mid-chain or automating level without touching the fader.

cards.title: Fruity PanOMatic
cards.summary: Pan and volume with an LFO: auto-pan and tremolo effects.

cards.title: Fruity Filter
cards.summary: Simple resonant filter (cutoff, resonance, low/band/high-pass) for sweeps you automate.

cards.title: Fruity Free Filter
cards.summary: One flexible filter: choose type (low/high/band-pass, notch, shelf, peak), frequency, Q and gain.

cards.title: Fruity Fast LP
cards.summary: Very light low-pass filter (cutoff + resonance) - cheap on CPU.

cards.title: Fruity Love Philter
cards.summary: Up to 8 filters in a chain, each with drawn, tempo-synced envelopes for cutoff, volume, pan... Rhythmic filtering, gates and pumping effects.

cards.title: Fruity Formant Filter
cards.summary: Vowel filter: morphs between a-e-i-o-u formants for talking/wah sounds.

cards.title: Fruity Blood Overdrive
cards.summary: Tube-style overdrive with pre/post filters; x100 switch for extreme drive.

cards.title: Fruity Fast Dist
cards.summary: Simple, light distortion: pre gain, threshold, mix, post gain, two curve types.

cards.title: Fruity Squeeze
cards.summary: Lo-fi destroyer: bit/rate reduction-style crunch with a filter.

cards.title: Fruity WaveShaper
cards.summary: Draw the curve that maps input to output level: gentle saturation to hard clipping.

cards.title: Fruity Soft Clipper
cards.summary: Rounds off peaks above a threshold - transparent loudness on drums and the master before a limiter.

cards.title: Distructor
cards.summary: Modular multi-effect for distortion and character: chain drive, filter, chorus/flanger, delay modules.

cards.title: Hardcore (guitar FX)
cards.summary: Guitar multi-effect pedalboard: distortion, amp/cab, chorus, delay, wah and more, in a pedal chain.

cards.title: Fruity Chorus
cards.summary: Classic chorus: delay, depth, stereo and LFO controls for thickening.

cards.title: Fruity Flanger
cards.summary: Flanger: short swept delay with feedback for jet-like sweeps.

cards.title: Fruity Flangus
cards.summary: Chorus/flanger hybrid with multiple voices.

cards.title: Fruity Phaser
cards.summary: Phaser with sweep frequency/depth, feedback and stages.

cards.title: Vintage Chorus
cards.summary: Emulation of a classic synth-style chorus: lush, wide, slightly noisy.

cards.title: Vintage Phaser
cards.summary: Vintage phaser emulation.

cards.title: Fruity Vocoder
cards.summary: Classic vocoder: a voice (modulator) shapes a synth (carrier). Feed both into its mixer track and set which input is which in its routing settings.

cards.title: Vocodex
cards.summary: Advanced vocoder with many bands, envelope and formant controls; works from a sidechain or a built-in synth carrier.

cards.title: Gross Beat
cards.summary: Time and volume manipulator: draws envelopes for playback position and volume per beat - stutters, half-time, tape stops, gates and sidechain-like pumping.
controls: presets of position envelopes (half speed, reverse, scratch)
tips: Volume slot pump presets are a quick sidechain alternative.

cards.title: Pitcher
cards.summary: Real-time pitch correction and harmonizer: snaps a voice to a key/scale (hard = robotic, slow = natural) or plays harmonies from MIDI.

cards.title: NewTone
cards.summary: Note-by-note pitch and time editor for monophonic audio (vocals): detects notes, lets you drag, correct and flatten them, then sends the fixed audio back.

cards.title: NewTime
cards.summary: Time-correction/warping editor: move markers to fix timing or reshape the groove of audio.

cards.title: Edison
cards.summary: Audio editor and recorder that lives in a mixer slot: record, cut, normalize, denoise, find loops, slice, then drag audio into the playlist.
controls: arm and record what the track plays (or its input)
learn a noise profile and remove it
drag the selection into the playlist / channel rack

cards.title: Transient Processor
cards.summary: Boost or tame the attack and sustain of sounds - punchier or softer drums without compression.

cards.title: Frequency Shifter
cards.summary: Shifts all frequencies by a fixed amount (inharmonic, metallic) and ring-modulates - sound design and subtle stereo movement.

cards.title: Frequency Splitter
cards.summary: Splits audio into frequency bands so each band can be processed separately (multiband processing with any plugin).

cards.title: Pitch Shifter
cards.summary: Real-time pitch and formant shifting for voices and instruments.

cards.title: Effector
cards.summary: 12 performance effects (distortion, filter, delay, flanger, phaser, bitcrush...) with an X/Y pad for live tweaks.

cards.title: Patcher
cards.summary: Plugin rack: wire several plugins (and controllers) together inside one slot, save the whole chain as one preset, expose macro knobs.
tips: Save favourite chains (vocal chain, master chain) as Patcher presets to load in one click.

cards.title: Fruity Peak Controller
cards.summary: Turns a track's loudness into a control signal you link to any knob (multilink / 'Link to controller'). Volume ducking, auto-filter, envelope following.

cards.title: Fruity Formula Controller
cards.summary: Controller whose output is a formula of three knobs and time - custom modulation.

cards.title: Fruity X-Y Controller
cards.summary: X/Y pad that outputs two control values to link to knobs - morph two parameters with one move.

cards.title: Fruity Send
cards.summary: Sends audio to another mixer track from a point inside the effect chain (e.g. pre-EQ send or a sidechain feed).

cards.title: Fruity Mute 2
cards.summary: Mutes left/right/both - an automatable mute switch in the chain.

cards.title: Fruity Phase Inverter
cards.summary: Flips polarity of left, right or both - fix out-of-phase mics or layered kicks.

cards.title: Fruity Center
cards.summary: Removes DC offset (a constant shift that wastes headroom).

cards.title: Fruity Scratcher
cards.summary: Turntable-style scratching of the audio passing through.

cards.title: Fruity Spectroman
cards.summary: Spectrum analyser - see where the energy sits.

cards.title: Wave Candy
cards.summary: Visual analyser: oscilloscope, spectrum, peak/loudness meter and vectorscope views.

cards.title: Fruity dB Meter
cards.summary: Simple level meter.

cards.title: Tuner
cards.summary: Chromatic tuner for instruments and samples.

cards.title: ZGameEditor Visualizer
cards.summary: Makes audio-reactive visuals and can render a video of the song (text, images, effects reacting to the music).

cards.title: Fruity Video Player
cards.summary: Plays a video in sync with the song - for scoring to picture.

cards.title: Fruity Notebook 2
cards.summary: Text notes saved in the project (lyrics, to-dos); pages can follow the song position.

cards.title: Fruity Big Clock
cards.summary: Large song-position display (bars or time).
